title: U.S. House · Texas's 19th District
area: West Texas, including Lubbock and Abilene.

context.text: This is an open seat: incumbent Jodey Arrington did not appear on the ballot in the March 3, 2026 Republican primary for the redrawn 19th District. Tom Sell won the Republican nomination in a May 26, 2026 primary runoff over Abraham Enriquez after leading a seven-candidate March primary field. Kyle Rable ran unopposed for the Democratic nomination.

candidates.name: Tom Sell
candidates.ballotNote: Won the May 26, 2026 Republican primary runoff over Abraham Enriquez, 64.3% to 35.7%.

priorities.text: Says he will fight for the agriculture industry, the energy production sector, hospitals, communities and infrastructure in the district.

candidates.researchNotes: Campaign site tomsell.com/tomsellforcongress.com now resolve to parked domains; site headings only via Ballotpedia's quote of the site (not used). Interviews (KTAB, Texas Tribune) contain no direct statements on the listed issues. No Candidate Connection survey. A campaign website (selltexastrue.com) was found; no Candidate Connection survey was located.

candidates.name: Kyle Rable
candidates.ballotNote: Ran unopposed for the Democratic nomination, winning the March 3, 2026 primary with 100% of the vote.

positions.summary: His campaign website says Americans should not bear the burden of the President's trade war and that Congress should limit the White House's ability to impose the tariffs.
positions.quote: Americans should not bear the brunt of Trump's trade war with our longtime allies.

positions.summary: His campaign website calls healthcare a human right and says he will fight to protect Medicaid and Medicare from cuts and executive overreach.
positions.quote: Healthcare is a human right, and any elected official who promotes legislation that makes it harder for working Americans to have access to healthcare must be voted out.

positions.summary: His campaign website says he would co-sponsor legislation to rescind the war powers given to the President and that Congress must reassert its authority.
positions.quote: As your Congressman, I will co-sponsor legislation to rescind the war powers given to the President to prevent more endless wars in the Middle East.

candidates.researchNotes: Campaign website rableforwesttexas.com has a short biography; no Candidate Connection survey was located.

researchNotes: This is an open seat after Texas redrew its congressional map for 2026; incumbent Jodey Arrington did not run in the redrawn 19th District's primary. Neither general-election nominee has completed a Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey or published detailed policy positions online. Biographies draw on candidate websites and local news; neither nominee's birth year is published in the sources reviewed.
